kind: dated amendment of the frozen ABL-MYR-1b comparability check after an implementation defect; post-hoc like the check itself

original_attempt.outcome: check_incomplete, stop S3: ValueError: duplicate index group 'MYRP'
original_attempt.note: the attempt files were renamed with the suffix _attempt1 and are otherwise unchanged; nothing was computed after the stop (no md.tpr was loaded)

defect: parse_ndx in the frozen run_comp_check.py rejects a repeated group name. GROMACS index files may repeat names: the published index.ndx files repeat the make_ndx default residue-name groups (ATP, MG, NA, CL, and MYRP in the Myr system). The tc groups named in production_md.mdp are not among the repeated names (seen from the group headers and sizes only, after the stop)

change.parse_ndx: repeated names are accepted; a name whose occurrences have identical atom lists keeps that list; a name whose occurrences differ is marked ambiguous
change.tc_group_check: a tc group whose name is ambiguous fails the K3 rule with the cause 'ambiguous group'; otherwise the frozen rule is applied unchanged

unchanged: check_spec.json (questions, rules, constants, criteria K1-K5, stop conditions, budget) and every other function of run_comp_check.py, which is imported byte-identical; no threshold is changed
